items.title: Lee Collins Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: Udell Wilson, Inez Trepani on drum, a boy called Georgie Boy, a clarinet, they're all dead now.

ctx.x: Oh, I heard, yeah, Manuel Moneta talking about it. And Manuel Moneta was in the band.
Udell Wilson, Inez Trepani on drum, a boy called Georgie Boy, a clarinet, they're all dead now. All but Manuel. Manuel looked fine last time I said it.
Well he said to tell everybody how low for him too. Yeah, they look good, Manuel did. He's pretty heavy, but he's good health though.
